issues.description: Render strokes are thinner than the original: solid edges look about half as heavy, and the dash pattern is finer and tighter than the original's bolder dashes.
issues.suggestion: Increase the global line width (e.g. from 1.1pt to about 1.6–1.8pt) and set a longer dash pattern, e.g. dash pattern on=5pt off=4pt, to match the original weight.
